scope: Full publisher dictionary metadata extraction for all pinned iQIES Q3 2026 fields; not a raw provider data profile or complete interpretation/normalization approval.

candidates.label: Provider Number
candidates.definition: Six or ten position identification number that is assigned to a certified provider. This is the CMS Certification Number (CCN).

candidates.label: Facility Name
candidates.definition: Name of the provider certified to participate in the Medicare and/or Medicaid programs.

candidates.label: Provider Subtype ID
candidates.definition: Identifies the subtype of the provider, within the primary category. Used in reporting to show the breakdown of provider categories.

candidates.label: Medicaid Vendor Number
candidates.definition: Number which may be assigned to a provider by the state Medicaid agency for external control or billing purposes.

candidates.label: Original Participation Date
candidates.definition: Date a provider is first approved to provide Medicare and/or Medicaid services.

candidates.label: Provider Type ID
candidates.definition: Identifies the type of provider participating in the Medicare/Medicaid program.

candidates.label: Address: Street
candidates.definition: Street address where the provider is located.

candidates.label: Address: City
candidates.definition: City in which the provider is physically located.

candidates.label: Social Security Administration County Code
candidates.definition: Social Security Administration geographic code indicating the county where the provider is located.

candidates.label: ZIP Code
candidates.definition: Five-digit ZIP code for a provider's physical address.

candidates.label: Telephone Number
candidates.definition: Telephone number of the provider.

candidates.label: Certification Date
candidates.definition: The most recent certification date for the provider.

candidates.label: Termination or Expiration Date
candidates.definition: Date the provider was terminated.

candidates.label: State Abbreviation
candidates.definition: Two-character state abbreviation.

candidates.label: Social Security Administration State Code
candidates.definition: Social Security Administration geographic code indicating the state where the provider is located.

candidates.label: State Region Code
candidates.definition: Identifies the region within a state where the provider is located.

candidates.label: Region Code
candidates.definition: The CMS Regional Office where a particular provider is located.

candidates.label: FIPS State Code
candidates.definition: FIPS State Code

candidates.label: FIPS County Code
candidates.definition: FIPS County Code

candidates.label: CBSA Code
candidates.definition: CBSA (Core Based Statistical Area) geographic entities defined by the U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) on June 6, 2003 for use by Federal statistical agencies in collecting, tabulating, and publishing Federal statistics. CBSA collectively refers to MSA.

candidates.label: CBSA (Core Based Statistical Area) Urban Rural Indicator
candidates.definition: CBSA (Core Based Statistical Area) indicates whether the county is defined as Urban or Rural.

candidates.label: Accreditation Type Code
candidates.definition: Indicates the accrediting organization deeming the provider. If a provider is deemed by multiple accrediting organizations then the accrediting organization with the earliest active deeming effective date is displayed in this field.

candidates.label: Intermediary or Carrier Code
candidates.definition: Number assigned to the Medicare Administrative Contractor, intermediary or carrier servicing this provider.

candidates.label: Compliance: Acceptable Plan of Correction
candidates.definition: Indicates if a provider is in compliance with program requirements based on an acceptable plan for correction of deficiencies.

candidates.label: Fiscal Year End Date (MM-DD)
candidates.definition: End date, consisting of the month and day, of the provider's fiscal year.

candidates.label: Compliance Status Code
candidates.definition: Compliance status of a provider at the time of certification survey.

candidates.label: Type of Action Code
candidates.definition: Identifies the reason for the certification and the type of action from the official survey record.

candidates.label: Change of Ownership Date
candidates.definition: Effective date of the most recent change of ownership for this provider.

candidates.label: Pharmacy Code
candidates.definition: Indicates how pharmaceutical services are provided.

candidates.label: Home Health Aide Code
candidates.definition: Indicates how home health aide services are provided.

candidates.label: Laboratory Code
